neighbours.label: 'reflect' in the sense of thinking back (a moment to reflect, reflecting on the past); mirrors reflecting light, and figures reflecting a cause, stay quiet
fire: Take a moment to reflect on what you have learned.
She sat quietly, reflecting on her years abroad.
He reflects on his childhood in a new memoir.
We paused to reflect before the next meeting.
The author reflects on the war in the last chapter.
Retirement gave him time to reflect.
After the match, reflecting on it, the coach praised his team.
Many visitors stop here to reflect and pray.
quiet: Glass and water reflect light in the sun.
She sat quietly, knitting a scarf for her son.
His results reflect his hard work this year.
We paused to eat before the next meeting.
These numbers reflect the state of the market.
Retirement gave him time to travel.
After the match, the coach praised his team.
Many visitors stop here to rest and eat.
